subject: maths
title: Variables & Like Terms
welcome_lead: Letters can stand in for numbers. Learn to simplify expressions by collecting the ones that match.
meta_desc: Learn variables and how to simplify like terms in this KS3 algebra adventure.
final_note: Great job! You can now tame messy expressions.

concepts.def: A letter that represents an unknown number.
A single number, variable, or product of them.
Terms with the same variable to the same power.
The number multiplying a variable, e.g. 3 in 3x.
A combination of terms without an equals sign.
A term that is just a number, with no variable.

walkthroughs.body_html:
To simplify 3x + 2x, add the coefficients: 3 + 2 = 5. So 3x + 2x = 5x.

You can only add or subtract like terms — terms with the same letter.

free_texts.q: What name is given to the number in front of a variable, like the 4 in 4x?
